notes.title: v0.5.0 - New Character and Game Mode
notes.content:
Greetings garbage guzzlers!

I'm going to make this short and sweet. There's a new character! His name is Squirrel, he is holier than thou, and he rides a chicken named Chicken.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44187581/a757f775607d244ab4015f24bae0e850d82582bd.gif[/img]

Also there's a new game mode! Battle rats in the dark with limited vision and spoooooky ghosts!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44187581/8f6529ee0c4b2ab6bc306e81ab5b4cf636786c63.gif[/img]

Also I updated a ton of other things and there's new abilities and idk go check it out it's good!

Here's my attempt at a change list:
[list]
[*] A squirrel approaches!
[*] Added a new game mode (Midnight)
[*] Captains now generally apply their effects permanently to all rats within 3 tiles
[*] Allies can now be revived by spending 1 trash from your Hoard (previously just referred to as the trash you can lose before you lose the game)
[*] Your Hoard now has more trash in it
[*] Rebalanced some levels, and added a bunch of new levels to Act II
[*] New Skunk ability: Shape Arcana
[*] New Possum ability: Poison Polyps
[*] New Possum ability: Infectious Toxins
[*] New Raccoon ability: Bountiful Opportunity
[*] Other stuff I'm sure I forgot to mention
[/list]

notes.title: Patch Notes v0.4.2
notes.content:
Hello garbage guzzlers! I've been hard at work on a new character, but I do have a little list of fixes and quality of life improvements here - I'm going to glob together the patch notes for v0.4.1 and v0.4.2, because I forgot to do a post for v0.4.1, but if you've played since last weekend you've likely been already playing v0.4.1, soooo ignore those!

[h2]v0.4.1[/h2]
[list]
[*]Fixed Rocks of Popping so they wouldn't permanently double a character's attack damage
[*]Resolved an issue where an effect from the Act 2 boss was disabling Badger's Resolve ability and making all of her abilities unusable
[*]Leftovers will now properly grant a minion on the next level if you had one and you select it during the last boon select of a level
[*]Made the End of Turn confirmation less annoying for Minions
[*]Miscellaneous visual fixes
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44187581/5652d431ebce667dad24f6347921f42353397cdd.gif[/img]

[h2]v0.4.2[/h2]
[list]
[*]Fixed issues with knockback effects stacking units on top of each other
[*]Fixed a few issues with sound effects not having their volume reduced by the SFX volume slider
[*]Fixed House Cat / Minion's interactions with her halved stats and the Orb items
[*]Fixed an issue where the game would crash if you pressed the save for later hotkey while you were choosing an item
[*]Added new attack icons for non-melee characters, to better visually signify that they are not melee
[*]Added a "save and quit" button to the menu in the continue screen after the upgrade minigame which I can't refer to by the name everyone thinks of because of trademark issues
[*]Fixed Gravity II to actually give the extra range it says it gives
[*]Changed Dash to deal 50% of Raccoon's attack damage (Dash II remains the same at 100%)
[*]Coupon of Savings now works with Minions
[*]Rocks of Popping now works properly with Charge
[/list]

notes.title: We're in Early Access!
notes.content:
Dearest dumpster divers! The time has come, the access is early, and the game is ready for to buy!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44187581/d4f5797b51cf7c88a3199d5117ae88106f54ccf2.gif[/img]

- Come check out a brand spankin' new Act II, where you'll battle a fiendish INVENTOR

And tell me all about it in our Discord!!

notes.title: Trash of the Titans v0.2 "Fur Goblins"
notes.content:
Helloooo trash fans! I've got some updates for you :D

[h1]Captains[/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44187581/23da18a115c9c192f3b589d88da994716a6c3f4c.png[/img]
Every non-boss battle now includes a Captain! Captains grant special bonuses to nearby rats, giving each battle a special spicy flavor to savor.

[h1]New Abilities[/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44187581/0c54bb4ffcfc80bb0afdc3367e12d4c851904c6f.gif[/img]
Zap enemies with Skunk's Lightning, swippity Swap places with enemies as Raccoon, or do Other Stuff with the other trash animals!

[h1]Trinkets[/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44187581/720cf0965f9d2d19c4874d3b31ee0360c555d44a.png[/img]
You'll now find special Trinkets in the trash which grant special effects when eaten. Tasty!

[h1]Other Stuff[/h1]
Okay so there's a lot of random changes in this update, like STAIRS, and every level was redesigned, and there's NEW ENEMIES!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44187581/de56771b6968454221b9a6b3f464fc8deee9b031.png[/img]

Give it a go, I think you'll find something you like :)
